mf_definition: LightGCN layer=0 is MF/BPR with matched N(0,0.1) initialization. Native PureMF default N(0,1) is deliberately not mixed into the graph ablation.
selection: Best overall validation NDCG@20 independently inside each common 30/100 epoch window. Every subgroup and Recall uses that same epoch. No current-protocol test evaluation.

public.selection: Author default rounded validation Recall@10; original patience rule after epoch index>100, 20 evaluations, strict improvement only. Test deferred until stopping, evaluated once per seed with the selected checkpoint.
public.test_masks: One scoring pass reports both original author compressed validation masking and corrected user-aligned masking. 3507 test users are absent from validation. Neither test metric influences selection.
public.purpose: Independent author-code and author-split calibration; never compare raw scores to the current engagement/random-exposure protocol.
